title: From Prediction Markets To Capability Markets: Epistemic Extractivism In Generative AI
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society
why: Names epistemic extractivism inside the GenAI stack and links platform design to who gets to know what. It joins your AI strand to your epistemic-justice reading in one argument.
caveat: A critical argument, not a measurement of extraction. The claims about platform behaviour rest on public statements.
